description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for stool shotgun/amplicon sequencing of gut microbiota from patients undergoing antibiotic treatment, capturing host, clinical, dietary, medication, and laboratory protocol information relevant to microbial diversity and resistance-gene analyses.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record.

patient_id.descr: Persistent de-identified identifier for the patient/source individual, if multiple samples are linked to one person.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or cohort.

sample_type.descr: Biological material collected; expected value: stool.

body_site.descr: Anatomical source of the sample; expected value: gut/feces/stool.

collection_date.descr: Date of stool sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_timepoint.descr: Relative timing of collection with respect to antibiotic exposure, e.g. pre-treatment, during treatment, post-treatment, follow-up.

days_from_antibiotic_start.descr: Number of days between the start of the antibiotic regimen and sample collection; negative values allowed for pre-treatment samples.

days_from_antibiotic_end.descr: Number of days between the end of antibiotic treatment and sample collection; negative values allowed if collected before treatment ended.

patient_age_years.descr: Age of the patient at sampling in years.

patient_sex.descr: Biological sex of the patient, if recorded; examples: female, male, intersex, unknown.

patient_gender.descr: Gender identity as recorded, if available; use controlled terms where possible.

patient_bmi.descr: Body mass index at or nearest to sampling, in kg/m^2.

patient_health_status.descr: Overall health status or clinical category relevant to the study; examples: healthy, hospitalized, infectious disease, inflammatory bowel disease, other.

primary_diagnosis.descr: Primary clinical diagnosis or indication for antibiotic use, if applicable.

comorbidities.descr: Comma-separated list or standardized terms for relevant comorbid conditions.

diet_pattern.descr: Dietary pattern at or near sampling; examples: omnivore, vegetarian, vegan, high_fiber, enteral_feeding, fasting, unknown.

diet_notes.descr: Additional diet information relevant to microbiome composition, such as recent dietary restriction or supplements.

probiotic_use.descr: Whether the patient was using probiotics near the sampling time.

prebiotic_use.descr: Whether the patient was using prebiotics or fiber supplements near the sampling time.

medication_use_other_than_antibiotic.descr: Other medications used near sampling that may affect the gut microbiome, excluding the study antibiotic; free-text or standardized list.

antibiotic_name.descr: Name of the antibiotic administered, preferably generic name.

antibiotic_class.descr: Pharmacological class of the antibiotic; examples: beta-lactam, macrolide, fluoroquinolone, tetracycline, glycopeptide.

antibiotic_route.descr: Route of antibiotic administration; examples: oral, intravenous, intramuscular, topical.

antibiotic_dose.descr: Dose of the antibiotic administered per administration, in standard units (e.g. mg).

antibiotic_dose_unit.descr: Unit for antibiotic_dose; examples: mg, g, mL.

antibiotic_frequency.descr: Dosing frequency; examples: once_daily, twice_daily, every_8h.

antibiotic_duration_days.descr: Planned or actual duration of antibiotic treatment in days.

antibiotic_combination_therapy.descr: Whether more than one antibiotic was administered concurrently.

other_antibiotics.descr: Names of additional antibiotics used concurrently, if any.

hospitalization_status.descr: Whether the patient was hospitalized at sampling time.

icu_status.descr: Whether the patient was in intensive care at sampling time.

stool_collection_method.descr: Method used to collect stool, such as home kit, bedside collection, or clinic collection.

stool_collection_container.descr: Type of collection container or preservative device used.

sample_preservative.descr: Preservative or stabilization reagent used immediately after collection, if any.

time_to_freezing_hours.descr: Time from collection to freezing or long-term storage, in hours.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature for the sample in degrees Celsius.

transport_condition.descr: Condition during transport; examples: on_ice, room_temperature, dry_ice, refrigerated.

dna_rna_extracted.descr: Whether nucleic acid extraction yielded DNA, RNA, or both; for sequencing studies this is usually DNA.

extraction_kit.descr: Name of the nucleic acid extraction kit or protocol used.

extraction_method.descr: Extraction method category; examples: bead_beating, chemical_lysis, enzymatic_lysis, automated.

extraction_date.descr: Date nucleic acid extraction was performed in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

input_material_mass_mg.descr: Mass of stool input into extraction, in milligrams.

input_material_volume_ml.descr: Volume of homogenized sample input, in milliliters, if applicable.

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: Concentration of extracted DNA measured before library preparation, in ng/µL.

dna_total_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield from extraction, in ng.

dna_purity_a260_a280.descr: DNA purity ratio A260/A280 from spectrophotometry.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol name.

library_prep_method.descr: Library construction approach; examples: shotgun, amplicon_16S, metagenomic, metatranscriptomic.

target_gene_region.descr: Targeted locus if amplicon sequencing was used; examples: 16S_V3V4, 16S_V4, ITS1. Use 'none' for shotgun sequencing.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR cycles used during library preparation or amplification.

indexing_strategy.descr: Indexing/barcoding strategy used for multiplexing; examples: dual_index, single_index, combinatorial.

library_size_selection_bp.descr: Approximate insert or size-selection range in base pairs, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology/platform used; examples: Illumina MiSeq, Illumina NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific instrument model used for sequencing.

sequencing_read_type.descr: Read configuration; examples: single_end, paired_end, long_read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or flow cell.

sequencing_center.descr: Laboratory or facility where sequencing was performed.

sequencing_date.descr: Date the sequencing run was initiated or completed in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

raw_reads_count.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for the sample.

filtered_reads_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering.

host_dna_fraction.descr: Estimated fraction of reads mapping to host DNA, if computed.

neg_control_processed.descr: Whether a negative extraction or library control was processed alongside the sample.

batch_id.descr: Laboratory batch identifier for extraction/library preparation to support batch-effect correction.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for a technical replicate, if applicable.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name or version of the bioinformatics pipeline used for analysis.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or resistance-gene assignment, if applicable.

taxonomic_profiling_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic profiling; examples: 16S_qiime2, kraken2, metaphlan, custom_pipeline.

resistance_gene_detection_method.descr: Method used to identify antimicrobial resistance genes; examples: alignment_based, kmer_based, assembly_based.

relative_abundance_summary.descr: Optional summary statistic for the microbial community, such as Shannon diversity or other computed metric, if stored at record level.

notes.descr: Additional free-text annotations relevant to this sample record.
